item.tib: shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa mngon par rtogs pa lam gyi rim pa 'grel ba dang bcas kyi mtha' dpyod dbyar gyi rnga sgra blo gsar mdongs mtha' dga' ba'i dgyes glu
item.coloph: smras pa/ rgyal gsung bdud rtsi'i sgo mo brgyad khri'i yang snying sbas don mngon rtogs tshul/ bsil ljongs skal bzang gdul bya'i bgo skal spel mdzad mkhas mchog dpal chen po'i/ byin rlabs mthu las mdo 'grel kun gyi tshig don thar 'dod rnams kyi lam/ rab tu gsal byed mkhan chen nyin byed dbang po'i bka' drin gzhal nus ci// 7 rnam 'dren dmu sras bka' lung dri bral 'chi med rgyu ba'i lam yangs por/ blo chung ra yig gnyis pa'i 'dab mas gzhal bar bya nus ga la yang / bshad sgrab ke sa ra 'dzum 'dus grwa'i skyed tshal gsar du bzhed pa'i tshe/ spro ba'i sems pas gtan tshigs dar dir sgogs bzhin g.yo ba dngos po'i gshis// shin tu dpag dka' rgyal yum khams brgyad kyi/ don bzang sbas don bdud rtsi'i legs bltams pa'i/ rnam bshad bum bzang ljon pa'i kha rgyan du/ mtha' dpyod mdongs ldan sgro yi phreng 'di spud// g.yung drung bstan la lhag bsam dkar ba'i cha gang ba/ yongs 'dzin blo gros bdud rtsi'i zer ldan gang de yis/ bon sbyin 'dzad med snang ba spro bas legs bskul tshe/ sher phyin thal phreng ku mud tshul 'di bzhad par 'os// 7 'on kyang rnam dpyod a dar+sha yi ngos/ tshul mthong dri mas sbag bzhin tha snyad kyi/ thos bsam byi dor dben pas gzhung lugs ni/ tshul bzhin ma mthong de dag bzod par gsol/ 7 'di byas bsod nams gshen bstan chu 'dzin lang long g.yo ba'i dbus/ sgra tshad bshad sgrub dbyar gyi rnga gsang dal gyis brdung ba'i mthus/ dge legs sprin gyi me tog 'dzam gling mtha' dbus kun 'thor nas/ mtha' klas 'gro rnams rgyal ba'i yum gyi 'bras bu g.yur za shog zhes shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa mngon rtogs lam gyi rim pa'i mtha' dpyod kyi bar skabs tshigs su bcad pa'o//
